notes.title: 🚀 Life Sim Development Update – Early Access Plans!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I’m excited to officially announce Life Sim, a deep text-based life simulation game where your choices shape your journey! As a solo developer at Isolated Limited, I’ve been working hard to bring this vision to life, and I can’t wait to share more with you.

🎮 What is Life Sim?
Life Sim is a turn-based life simulation game where you navigate careers, properties, social media, and city dynamics. Every choice matters, and when your character’s story ends, a new one begins.

Core Features at Launch:
✅ Time advances monthly and quarterly
✅ Career system – Start a job, get promoted, or switch careers
✅ Property management – Buy, sell, and upgrade real estate
✅ Social media system – Build an online presence & interact with trends
✅ City economy & events – Watch the world around you evolve over time

This is just the beginning! I plan to launch in Early Access and continue adding features with regular updates based on community feedback.

🛠 Future Updates (Subject to Change)
I plan to expand Life Sim over time with regular updates. Future updates may include:

🔹 More career paths & job opportunities
🔹 Expanded social media interactions
🔹 More city events & economy changes
🔹 Character customization & personality traits
🔹 Deeper life progression & generational gameplay

These features are not set in stone but represent the direction I’d like to take the game based on player feedback.
